ld.description: California Gold Nutrition Snack Bar Variety Pack Includes 6 Flavors: Wild Blueberry & Almond , Cranberry & Almond , Coconut Almond , Mocha Nut , Peanut & Dark Chocolate Chunk , Dark Chocolate, Nuts, & Sea Salt Made with Simple Ingredients: Roasted Almonds, Ancient Grains, Peanuts, Walnuts, Goji Berries, and Honey A Good Source of Plant Based Protein and Dietary Fiber Suitable for Vegetarians No Artificial Colors, Flavors, Sweeteners, or Preservatives Formulated without GMOs Produced in a 3rd Party Audited cGMP Registered (Certified) Facility 100% Gold Guarantee Finding satisfying healthy snacks is no easy task. The snacks that taste good are often packed with artificial ingredients and sugar, leaving you feeling defeated. Our snack bars offer the perfect balance between healthy and tasty, making them the gold standard for snacking. The next time you’re craving a bite, be sure to reach for one of these delicious bars. California Gold Nutrition Snack Bar Variety Pack contains a sample of our snack bar varieties. All 6 varieties are made with simple ingredients, like roasted almonds, ancient grains, goji berries, and peanuts to create a nutritious and satisfying treat with plenty of fiber and protein. Each bar is individually wrapped, making them perfect for on-the-go snacking anytime, anywhere.
